description: This Java class 'IgnitionMapBuilder' provides methods for calculating ignition timing advances based on various parameters such as chamber style, octane, compression, bore, RPM, and map sensor value. It includes enums, static methods for interpolation, correction calculations, and roundings, mainly used for engine ignition map tuning.

classes.name: IgnitionMapBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for building ignition maps with static methods to calculate ignition advance values based on engine parameters.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates the top ignition advance based on chamber style, octane level, compression ratio, and bore diameter.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between two points.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Returns the ignition advance value based on RPM and maximum advance.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Calculates the initial ignition advance based on RPM, MAP sensor value, and maximum advance.

methods.name: round10
methods.description: Rounds a double value to one decimal place.

methods.name: getBoreCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction value based on bore diameter.
